hook: 门口那个人一直没进来。

clips.title: 老样子

action.text: 她把一包素白烟盒推过台面
action.en: she slides a plain white cigarette pack across the counter

action.text: 老周推门出去，门外雨里站着一个撑伞的人影
action.en: the older man pushes out into the rain where a figure with an umbrella stands outside

move.why: 推向门外那个人影，悬念收紧

shots.name: 台面
shots.hand: 阿青的右手（年轻女人的手，深蓝色旧袖口）
shots.hand_en: the clerk's right hand (a young woman's hand, worn dark-blue cuff)

action.text: 她的手停在零钱上没收
action.en: her hand stops on the change without picking it up

signature.why: 冷白灯管里推向门外雨中的人影，风铃一响

clips.tension: 老周每天三点来；今天门外多了一个人，观众看见了，阿青还没看见
clips.summary_en: At three in the morning the regular customer buys his cigarettes and leaves; a figure with an umbrella waits outside.

clips.title: 门口
clips.summary: 黑衣人站在门口不进来

action.text: 门外的黑衣人背对着店，伞尖滴水，一动不动
action.en: outside, the man in black stands with his back to the shop, rain dripping from the umbrella tip, not moving
she looks up toward the door

clips.stillness: 门口的人一直不动，静是这一条的压力

turn.to: 门外有个人一直不进来

signature.why: 玻璃门外一动不动的背影，伞尖滴水

clips.tension: 观众和阿青都不知道他是谁，他一直不进来
clips.summary_en: A man in a long black coat stands outside the glass door with his back to the shop and never comes in.
